limits: Exact native batA / enBat01 / renderer 121104 source assignment only; no sibling source route or topology receives credit.
The ordinary no-focus hit reduced the same target from 58 HP to 48 HP; death used the separate explicit KillSingle fixture at 48 HP and is not ordinary lethal-damage evidence.
Twenty-two selected original PNGs were reviewed; the remaining 338 retained capture frames and generated videos are preserved evidence but were not individually reviewed.

The fixture death completed all 120 requested frames through batDeath with m_DoRagdoll=false and zero rigid bodies; this is animated death evidence, not ragdoll proof, and no corpse lifetime beyond the sampled window is claimed.

The exact renderer stayed active, enabled and visible in all 360 retained frames; native combat UI, bright attack effects, foreground hero overlap, loot overlay, depth blur and camera motion limit fine inspection.
One native Collect reached strict Ready at level 0 room 2; broader campaign progression was not exercised.
Other controller clips, sibling bat sources, portraits, collision, extended culling, long-session resource lifetime and final art-direction approval remain outside this archive.
